props.label: Allow Note
props.description: This flag indicates whether or not to even allow the user to enter a note when this state is seleced from a control panel screen. Use the "require note" flag, if you want this note entry to be forced.

props.label: Select Blocking Workunit
props.description: Allows the operator to select an asset as the 'blocking' workunit. If you choose this option, the operator will select a specific workunit when this state is chosen.

props.label: Select Starving Workunit
props.description: Allows the operator to select an asset as the 'starving' workunit.

props.label: Default Starving Workunit
props.description: Does not allow the operator to change / select the starving workunit. This default will be used everytime this state is chosen.
